description: READ-PATH from the other side: the reader is frozen. Reader a opens the idx fixture shared read-only and runs SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(N), SUM(LEN(M)) FROM T; b suspends a 15 ms after the start signal and checks a had not returned, then opens shared read/write and runs UPDATE T SET N = N + 1000000 (dbFailOnError, Errors before/after, RecordsAffected), then resumes a. a reports its aggregates (the original SUM(N) is 83,906,560; a mixed value would be between it and 83,906,560 + 4,096,000,000). b finally reads fresh after a pause. Asks whether a reader stopped inside a scan blocks the writer, and whether its result is old, new or mixed.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
